def solve(x):
    def hizlish_op(xs: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        xs = xs[::-1]  # Rotate the list left by 4 positions
        xs = xs[xs.index(0) + 1:] + xs[:x.index(0) + 1]  # Multiply every element whose (0-based) index is divisible by 4 by 3
        return xs

    def baxvor_cv(n: int) -> int:
        n = abs(n)  # Use the digits of the absolute value
